name: Pokémon™ Version Bleue
description:
You've got to be the very best, like no one ever was - and the only way to do that is by catching all the Pokémon you can!

Your quest to catch 'em all and complete your Pokédex will take you all over the world, and maybe one day you'll even be able to defeat all the Gym Leaders and collect their badges!
disclaimer:
This software supports French only. Please search for another version of the title if you would like to play in a different language.

Communication and expansion features from the original game are not available in this version. Wireless battling and trading is supported with Pokémon Red, Pokémon Blue, or Pokémon Yellow Version.

This version of the game can only connect with Pokémon Red, Pokémon Blue, or Pokémon Yellow Version. It cannot connect with other Nintendo 3DS or Nintendo DS software.

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
